_description: Signer identities TAP accepts for an image's SBOM attestations (req-cicd-sbom-22). Default deny: an attestation whose signer is not listed here is refused, and an empty or unreadable list refuses everything. Read by scripts/sbom/select_input.py, which verifies each listed identity with `gh attestation verify --cert-identity` and, where the entry pins one, `--signer-digest`.

signers._description: The publish pipeline that builds the images and signs revision 1 of every image's SBOM. Its Build Signer Digest is the commit of the workflow file at each build and changes with every build, so it cannot be pinned (read: the verified attestation for tap-web sha256:a9149a88 had signer digest 7cc8f759...). The identity is pinned by repository, workflow file and ref; branch protection on main is the control on the ref.
signers.reason: Revision 1 is signed by publish-images.yml, whose signer digest moves with every build. Remove this entry when publish-images.yml calls the reusable workflow, so one signer with one pinned digest signs every revision.
signers.added_by: George, ruled in the rampart-pg-ci session on 2026-10-16 (Q7a)

signers._description: The reusable vulnerability-evidence workflow, called by commit. The certificate's signer identity ends in the commit the caller pinned, not in a branch, and its Build Signer Digest is that same commit, so both are pinned here. Observed on the first real run (run 38955198175): subject alternative name .../sbom-vulnerability-evidence.yml@5736329d..., Build Signer Digest 5736329d..., Build Config URI the dispatch caller on refs/heads/main.
signers.reason: Signs every revision after the first. Each change to the workflow is a new commit and a new caller pin, so a new entry here; the old entry stays so earlier revisions keep verifying, and is removed only by a reviewed change.
signers.added_by: George approved the first real signed run in the rampart-pg-ci session on 2026-10-16; this entry records the identity it produced

signers._description: The reusable vulnerability-evidence workflow at the commit that adds published date, title, description and record URLs to the vulnerability entries (revision 3 of tap-web). Called by commit like the previous entry, so the signer identity and the Build Signer Digest are that commit.
signers.reason: Signs revisions made by this version of the workflow. The previous version's entry stays so revisions it signed keep verifying.
